items.title: Trump threatens Iranian power plants and bridges if ships attacked in Hormuz
items.description: US strikes have already widened from the south to western and central areas of Iran in recent days.

items.title: Ukraine hits more warehouses of top Russian retailer Wildberries
items.description: Volodymyr Zelenskyy said Kyiv struck "logistics hubs" supplying the Russian army with "drone components, navigation equipment and other gear".

items.title: 'Turning point' for housing market as property prices hit three-year low
items.description: Australia's property market has entered a downturn after both house and unit prices fell for the first time in more than three years, bringing an end to the recent housing boom.

items.title: Nina Kennedy arrives early to lead Australia into Glasgow opening ceremony
items.description: Reigning Commonwealth Games gold medallists Nina Kennedy and Tim Hodge will carry the Australian flag and King's baton at the Glasgow 2026 opening ceremony.

items.title: French modelling scout with links to Epstein found dead, prosecutors say
items.description: A French modelling scout with close ties to the late US financier Jeffrey Epstein has been found dead at his home outside Paris, prosecutors say.

items.title: China demands Australia stop 'inciting confrontation' over South China Sea
items.description: China's Ministry of Foreign Affairs has demanded Australia stop "exaggerating tensions and inciting confrontation" over the South China Sea after Penny Wong warned Beijing against "destabilising" conduct in the region.

items.title: Meet the Australian multi-millionaire pardoned by Trump
items.description: Chris Wade was arrested by the Secret Service in Dallas in the early 2000s. It took him on a journey where he went from FBI hacker to Mar-a-Lago and eventually the White House before he came back to Australia to buy his favourite pub.

items.title: Anxiety as Australia issues new travel advice for Middle East countries
items.description: As conflict between the United States and Iran escalates once again, the Department of Foreign Affairs and Trade has issued a warning to "reconsider" travel to several more countries in the region.

items.title: Minister says Australian IS-linked 'Doctor Jihad' can 'rot' in Iraqi jail
items.description: Perth paediatrician Tareq Kamleh went to Syria to join the Islamic State group in 2015 and has, until now, been presumed dead.

items.title: Actor to appeal after losing defamation case against Rebel Wilson
items.description: Hollywood actor Rebel Wilson successfully defends a defamation case brought against her by the star of her directorial debut.

items.title: President Trump Announces U.S. Military Airstrike in Venezuela
items.description: President Trump states the U.S. military conducted its first known airstrike inside Venezuela targeting a dock where drugs were allegedly loaded onto boats[1][2][4].

items.title: Trump Meets Netanyahu at Mar-a-Lago for Gaza Ceasefire Phase Two Talks
items.description: President Trump met with Israeli Prime Minister Netanyahu to discuss advancing phase two of the Gaza ceasefire, including reconstruction and responses to Iran[1][4].

items.title: Feds Launch Massive Taxpayer Fraud Probe in Minnesota After Viral Video
items.description: Federal agencies including DHS, FBI, and ICE investigate $110 million in suspected fraud at Minnesota child care centers following a viral YouTube video[3].

items.title: Americans Express Widespread Opposition to AI Data Centers
items.description: Public backlash against AI infrastructure data centers grows, with protests and demands for bans influencing Democratic Party strategies for future elections[3].

items.title: Elon Musk's Humanoid Robot Vision: China Poised to Lead Production
items.description: China prioritizes humanoid robots in tech race with U.S., ramping up production while warning of industry bubble and potential bottlenecks[3].

items.title: Trump-Putin Call Amid Ukraine-Russia Tensions Over Peace Plan
items.description: President Trump spoke with Putin amid ongoing Ukraine conflict, with Russia reevaluating peace plan tenets after Ukrainian denials[1].

items.title: Democratic Gubernatorial Candidates in Wisconsin Focus on Inflation and Trump
items.description: Seven Democrats vying for Wisconsin governor blame economic issues on Trump and emphasize affordability ahead of 2026 primary[3].
